mods.name: Care For Them
mods.description: Bring Xoonglins to your world! Build homes, meet their needs, and watch their civilization grow. Fully customizable and perfect for modpacks!

releases.notes:
## Breaking changes
- Needs, social classes, structures and jobs take their id from their file path (`data/<namespace>/cft/<folder>/<name>.json`). The `id` field is gone.
- Social classes in datapacks moved to the `social_class/` folder.
- All datapack JSON fields use snake_case (e.g. `max_happiness`, `floor_blocks`, `min_quantity`).
- Fields for blocks, entity types, biomes and sounds take an id, a `#tag` or a list of them, replacing the `block` + `block_tag` pairs.
- Lang keys follow the vanilla style: `need.<namespace>.<name>`, `social_class.<namespace>.<name>`, `structure.<namespace>.<name>` and `job.<namespace>.<name>`.

## Features
- Introduced **schedules**: social classes and jobs can define when Xoonglins work, have free time and rest.
- Added **Sleep Need**: Xoonglins sleep in a bed of their home.
- Added **Visit Need**: Xoonglins visit a structure in their free time, optionally consuming items and taking them from the structure's containers.
- Added **Socialize Need**: Xoonglins meet and talk with other Xoonglins.
- Added **Hearing Need**: Xoonglins want to hear certain sounds and game events, or to not hear too many of them.
- Added `active_when` **conditions for needs** (time of day, weather, dimension, biome, any of, not). A need only applies while they hold, and shows greyed out in the info screen otherwise.
- Added new jobs: **Smelter** (furnaces, smokers and blast furnaces) and **Lumberjack** (fells whole trees).
- Added `requires_running` to Structure and Visit Needs: the structure only counts while a Xoonglin is working there.
- Added an optional lighting requirement for houses, enclosed buildings and multi-storey buildings.
- Structures are checked again before being used, and unregistered when they are no longer valid. Breaking the key block unregisters a structure, and clicking a registered structure with the Leader's Staff checks it again.
- Xoonglins can be spawned with spawn eggs, dispensers, `/summon` and the new `/xoonglin summon` command.
- Random names can be configured per social class (`name_samples`).
- Added an icon above Xoonglins showing their most pressing need, need tooltips, class change notifications, the Census dashboard and Jade integration.
- The job tab shows more detail: why a Xoonglin isn't working, its current work step and paused errands.
- Added an option for zombies to hunt Xoonglins.
- Added arm swing animation when a Xoonglin interacts with the world.
- **Addons** can listen to events (class change, job change, need state change and structure detection), add memories and behaviors to the Xoonglin brain, and add their own detection reasons and need condition types.
- The **documentation** moved to a website: https://hyperbaton.github.io/cft/

## Changes
- Redesigned the default datapack to show most of the mod's features. The new "Sample datapack" page of the documentation tells what each class shows.
- Structure detection messages are translatable.

## Fixes
- Fixed rendering of the humanoid model.
- Fixed Xoonglins getting stuck fetching supplies.
- Fixed unnatural spawning of Xoonglins: they now get a social class and a leader.
- Fixed the Leader's Staff recipe.

mods.name: Care For Them
mods.description: Bring Xoonglins to your world! Build homes, meet their needs, and watch their civilization grow. Fully customizable and perfect for modpacks!

releases.notes:
### Features
- Added `scope` field for social structure validation at social class changes, so percentages are computed with regards to a subset of social classes.
- Now when a Xoonglin is ready to mate, a small heart will be shown on its info screen.
- Added fields to select if a job is eligible for adults or babies.
- Added new jobs: **Blesser**, **Enchanter** and **Rancher** (this one needs improvements).
- Added new structure type: **Pasture** (an open field platform with mob presence requirement).

### Fixes
- Fixed mating delay, which was not being properly ticked.
- Xoonglins will no longer mate while working.
- Fixed being able to restart the workday by changing the assigned job.

mods.name: Care For Them
mods.description: Bring Xoonglins to your world! Build homes, meet their needs, and watch their civilization grow. Fully customizable and perfect for modpacks!

releases.notes:
### Features
- Introduced **Ritual** feature: represents any kind of event and is handled and configured via the Officiant job.
- Added new **Structure types**: Multi-storey building, compound.
- Added new **Jobs**: Hauler, Builder, Officiant, Crafter, Fisher, Healer, Quarry Miner.
- Added **Ritual Need**.
- Added minHappiness field for jobs (optional). They won't work unless they are happy enough.

### Changes
- Improved information shown in the job tab of Xoonglin's info.

### Fixes
- Fixed Xoonglins looking on the first container they find when working, now they will scan all the containers in the target structure.
- Xoonglins will now verify a structure's integrity before claiming it as users.
